english.note: Use this when pointing out, demonstrating, or comparing a specific quantity, as in “this much” or “that much.”
Use this for demonstrative or degree meanings such as “this many” and “so many.”

examples.english: Why do you need this much money?

examples.english: Why did you buy so many apples?
